name: WhatsAstra
description:
WhatsAstra brings WhatsApp to astraOS through WhatsApp Web.

Open it, then on your main phone go to WhatsApp > Linked devices > Link a device and scan the QR code. Your chats, voice notes and photos stay in sync, and new messages arrive as notifications.

WhatsAstra is not made by or affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.
notes: First release: chats, notifications with the unread count, attachments from Files, downloads, zoom, spell check.

story.title: Your chats, now on astraOS
story.subtitle: WhatsAstra links to WhatsApp in seconds
story.body: Scan one QR code from your main phone and every chat is here: voice notes, photos, groups and notifications.
